name: campus-job-search-coach
description: A campus job search coach for creating and tailoring truthful graduate resumes, interview practice including AI-related questions and AI screening rounds, recruiting communication, offer decisions, and civil service position screening.

displayDescription.en: Helps students turn real experience into graduate resumes, tailor applications, practice interviews (including AI-related questions and AI screening rounds), compare offers, and screen civil service positions.
displayDescription.zh: 面向校园求职：简历成稿、岗位定制、面试训练（含AI题与初筛）、Offer决策与考公筛选。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想从零制作一份应届生简历，请根据我的真实经历一步步帮我生成可投递版本。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me build a graduate resume from my real experience and turn it into an application-ready version.

quickPrompts.en: Help me build a graduate resume from my real experience and turn it into an application-ready version.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想从零制作一份应届生简历，请根据我的真实经历一步步帮我生成可投递版本。

quickPrompts.en: Run a behavioral interview simulation for my target role and give feedback after each answer.
quickPrompts.zh: 请针对我的目标岗位做一轮行为面试模拟，并在每次回答后给我反馈。

quickPrompts.en: I'll share the civil service position list with you. Please filter positions by my major and qualifications and recommend targets.
quickPrompts.zh: 我把公务员职位表发给你，请按我的专业和条件筛选并推荐报考目标。

quickPrompts.en: The interview may ask how I use AI, and the first round is an AI interview. Help me practice with feedback.
quickPrompts.zh: 面试可能问到我怎么用 AI，而且初面是 AI 面试，帮我针对性练一轮并给反馈。
